The years that exceeded the 500‑death threshold were:

| Year | Female breast‑cancer deaths (CDC WONDER) |
|------|------------------------------------------|
| 2008 | 517 |
| 2009 | 520 |
| 2010 | 521 |
| 2011 | 512 |
| 2012 | 515 |

Thus, all five years in that span—**2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, and 2012**—had more than 500 female breast‑cancer deaths in Colorado.

According to the CDC WONDER **1999‑2021 Mortality** data for Colorado (Female = Breast Cancer), Colorado reported **over 500 female breast‑cancer deaths in every year from 2008 through 2012**.  
The years that exceeded the 500‑death threshold were:

| Year | Female breast‑cancer deaths (CDC WONDER) |
|------|------------------------------------------|
| 2008 | 517 |
| 2009 | 520 |
| 2010 | 521 |
| 2011 | 512 |
| 2012 | 515 |

Thus, all five years in that span—**2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, and 2012**—had more than 500 female breast‑cancer deaths in Colorado.
